## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the user-visible problem and what this change delivers. Link the agreed issue or scope when applicable.

## Validation

Record the checks actually run and their outcomes. Include the failing/passing scenario when changing observable behavior, and explicitly list any checks not run or still failing. For documentation-only changes, link and formatting checks are sufficient.

## Review

- [ ] The change has one clear concern and follows the agreed product scope.
- [ ] Commits are small, and staged changes were reviewed before each commit.
- [ ] Validation matches the change; remaining failures or limitations are recorded.
- [ ] Examples, screenshots, and logs use synthetic or redacted data.

Mention any ADR, bilingual PRD, code-generation, or dependency-notice updates required by this change.
